season.evidence: Stored Jul-Sep (late July on). Web search (Mountaineers Spire Mountain page, summitpost) found no month guidance beyond a spring-to-fall remark; a May track met snow from about 4,400 ft and a moat, so May is offseason. Histogram: Aug 6, Jul 3, Sep 3.

track.why: We hold exactly one route on Spire Mountain and the Aug 15 2020 track follows its described line: from the FR-63 pullout, up the north side, across to the summit ridge and back to the same pullout, ending 4 m from our summit pin and 90 m from the trailhead pin.

otherTracksConsidered.why: May 27 with snow from about 4,400 ft; over a month before the stated late-July start.
Jul 20 2024 summit but no GPS track in the harvest; used for facts.

facts.text: Straight off the parking pullout the first stretch is thick fern hiding deadfall, which is slow in the dark in July; after the first old logging road the going is easier.
On the summit block, the blocky left side with ramps was firmer than the mossy, dirty right side (July).
30 m rope and a few slings for the rappel anchors above the crux (July)
Several false tops precede the true summit; a roughly 25 ft dirty notch must be downclimbed and re-climbed (July)

notes: Packet had one route. Report 2581936 (Jul 20 2024) has no harvested track but was used for in-season facts.
